reason: This plugin is a DeepSeek Harness web UI enhancement that injects a floating visual companion (Live2D/Cubism model), with configurable placement and size and cursor/state-driven animation behavior. Evidence points to a user-facing purpose of interface layout/visual augmentation rather than data processing, automation, or external service tooling.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供一个可配置的浮动 Live2D 桌宠，展示角色模型并根据状态和光标实现表情与视线联动。
summaries.en: Provides a configurable floating Live2D companion in the DeepSeek Harness web UI, rendering a model with state-based expression switching and cursor-responsive movement.

capabilities: Renders a floating Live2D canvas element in the web UI
Loads and displays configured Cubism 4 model assets
Updates model expression/state from host activity states
Tracks mouse movement to drive model eye/head parameters
Persists enable/disable preference via browser localStorage

reasons.code: README identifies the plugin as a Live2D companion that renders a Cubism model in the Web UI with state-driven expressions and mouse tracking.
README documents localStorage keys to toggle visibility and persistence behavior, indicating browser-side state control.
package.json declares DSH web client injection and bundle patch usage for cordis.patch.yml configuration, confirming UI-extension behavior in the web platform.
Repository metadata and description emphasize Live2D/pet and DeepSeek Harness plugin purpose.
